title: Follow Suggestions
content: Build follow suggestions section. Card grid: suggested user cards. Card content: avatar, name, username, mutual connections count ("12 mutual friends"), brief bio, Follow button. Reasons: "Based on your contacts", "Followed by [Friend]". Dismiss: X button to remove suggestion. Refresh: load more suggestions. Carousel: horizontal scroll on mobile.

variants.simple: Create "People you may know" suggestion cards.
variants.detailed: Build follow suggestions section. Card grid: suggested user cards. Card content: avatar, name, username, mutual connections count ("12 mutual friends"), brief bio, Follow button. Reasons: "Based on your contacts", "Followed by [Friend]". Dismiss: X button to remove suggestion. Refresh: load more suggestions. Carousel: horizontal scroll on mobile.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive follow suggestions with smart recommendations. Section container: "People You May Know" or "Suggested for You" heading, "See All" link. Layout options: horizontal carousel (default for in-feed placement), grid (for dedicated page). Horizontal carousel: flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 pb-4 snap-x, hide scrollbar, navigation arrows on desktop. User card: w-60 flex-shrink-0 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-4 border. Card content: avatar (w-16 h-16 rounded-full mx-auto), name (font-semibold text-center mt-3), username (text-gray-500 text-sm text-center), bio preview (text-sm text-gray-600 text-center line-clamp-2 mt-2), mutual indicator (text-xs text-gray-500 "12 mutual friends" or "Followed by John, Sarah"). Follow button: w-full mt-4 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg py-2 hover:bg-blue-600. Following state: button changes to "Following" with check, outline style. Dismiss: X button (absolute top-2 right-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600), removes card with animation, provides feedback to algorithm. Recommendation reasons (below username): "From your contacts", "Followed by [FriendName]" with friend's small avatar, "Based on your interests", "Popular in your network", "People who follow you also follow". Grid layout: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Suggestion sources: phone contacts (if imported), email contacts, mutual friends analysis, similar interests/bio, location-based, trending/popular users. Batch follow: "Follow All" button for multiple quick follows. Refresh: "Refresh suggestions" link or pull-to-refresh. Persistent dismissals: dismissed users don't reappear, stored server-side. A/B variants: different card layouts, with/without bio, single vs batch actions. Analytics: track follow rate, dismissal rate per suggestion source. Empty state: if no suggestions, prompt to import contacts or follow topics. Privacy: link to manage contact sync settings. Loading: skeleton cards while fetching. Accessibility: carousel keyboard navigable, follow buttons clearly labeled with username.
